# routeros_system_ntp_key (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_system_ntp_key" "key" {
  key_id  = 1
  key_val = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key_id` (Number) The key identifier - an integer identifying the cryptographic key used to generate the message authentication code.
- `key_val` (String, Sensitive) The value of the symmetric key shared with the NTP peer.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/system/ntp/key get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_system_ntp_key.key "*1"
```
